candidates.snippet: This activity underscores multilateral commitments to upholding the freedom of navigation and overflight, as well as respect for other maritime rights under international law, as reflected in the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS).

Japan Self-Defense Forces (JSDF), the United States Coast Guard (USCG), the Philippine Navy (PN), the Philippine Air Force (PAF) and the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) conducted a Multilateral Exercise as a Maritime Cooperative Activity.
In demonstrating a collective commitment to strengthening regional and international cooperation in support of a Free and Open Indo-Pacific, https://t.co/GKdZ2W4jG1
